title: Hospital discharge
what: When your hospital treatment is finished and you can go home. You get a discharge summary with advice.
why: When hospital treatment is complete, or when you can continue treatment at home.
duration: the paperwork usually takes from 1 to several hours on the day of discharge
tell_doctor: What worries you before going home
If there is no one to help you at home
If it is unclear how to take your medicines
If you need a sick note for work

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Find out the day before what time you will be discharged and who will pick you up.

prepare.title: Questions
prepare.text: Write down your questions: medicines, activity, diet, and when to see a doctor.

prepare.title: Things
prepare.text: Pack your things in advance, and check your bedside cabinet.

bring: Your things and clothes for the trip home
Your list of questions for the doctor
steps: The doctor does a final check
You get a discharge summary with your diagnosis and advice
The doctor explains which medicines to take and how
You are told when and which doctor to see next
A sick note is given, if needed
You collect your things and go home
feel: It can feel worrying to go home. That is normal
Weakness after hospital can last a few days
after: Keep your discharge summary and show it to your regular doctor
See your doctor at the clinic within the stated time
red_flags: You suddenly get much worse, with severe pain, a high fever, or trouble breathing: call emergency services
Any warning signs the doctor told you about at discharge

faq.q: What if something in the summary is unclear?
faq.a: Ask the doctor before you leave. Later, you can show it to your regular doctor.

faq.q: When should I see my regular doctor?
faq.a: Usually in the first days after discharge. The exact timing is written in your advice.

reminders.text: Discharge tomorrow. Pack your things, arrange a ride home, and write down your questions for the doctor.
